title: AI liquid-cooling systems
plain: Powerful computer racks produce more heat than ordinary fans can remove. This factory makes tested fluid assemblies that carry coolant safely between cooling equipment and the racks.
analogy: A carefully controlled radiator network for computers, with each joint and branch checked before delivery.
product: OEM-approved stainless-steel rack manifolds, hose/tube assemblies and pump/filter fluid modules, supplied with inspection records.
does: Distributes coolant evenly, keeps the loop clean and allows an integrator to install a repeatable assembly.
whyNow: Schneider launched a Motivair liquid-cooling factory in Bengaluru in February 2026. OCP is developing shared cooling interfaces and requirements. These establish a real ecosystem, not an order for this factory. [S1] [S2]
firstProduct: One customer-approved family of supply/return rack manifolds and associated pump/filter modules for single-phase water/glycol loops. Select material, interfaces and rated operating conditions with the customer before machine purchase.
notIncluded: No GPU chip manufacture, package-specific microchannel cold plates, proprietary quick-disconnect valves, complete megawatt CDU or semiconductor UHP gas system in the starter scope.
entry: Recruit a fluid-system manufacturing lead and win a paid prototype programme from a cooling OEM. Manufacture tubes, weldments and assemblies; buy approved pumps, couplings, sensors and controls. Outsource passivation and specialist corrosion/thermal qualification initially.
capacity: Planning assumption after qualification: 240 manifold sets and 60 small fluid modules per year, one 8-hour shift over 250 days. Product mix and test time must be measured during pilot builds.

budget.basis: INR crore on a September 2026 planning basis. Leased existing industrial shell; land purchase and new-building civil works excluded. Recoverable GST excluded, working capital separate, no subsidy deducted. Includes fixed equipment and stated pre-operative launch allowances; not an accounting classification or vendor quotation.

title: Precision parts for semiconductor equipment
plain: Make carefully measured metal parts that fit inside the machines used to manufacture chips. Begin with selected mechanical parts, then earn approval for more demanding assemblies.
analogy: Supply the accurately fitted bones and joints of a machine that makes chips.
product: Customer-drawing aluminium and stainless-steel brackets, mounting plates, supports and selected clean mechanical assemblies, with inspection and material records.
does: Gives equipment makers a qualified Indian source for repeat parts, engineering changes and local service stock.
customers: Semiconductor equipment OEMs and their approved contract manufacturers
Indian manufacturers building equipment or subsystems
Overseas equipment suppliers developing Indian sourcing
Equipment service companies with authorised replacement-part drawings
whyNow: Applied Materials describes expanding its India engineering and innovation presence. This supports an equipment ecosystem, but a research centre is not proof of an open purchase order for machined parts. UCT shows how specialised manufacturing and contamination control fit into the equipment supply chain. [S1] [S5]
firstProduct: One customer-approved family of non-process-contact brackets and mounting plates, initially within an assumed 500 mm part envelope. The RFQ must define material, datums, tolerances and finish; there is no universal semiconductor tolerance.
notIncluded: No wafer fabrication, complete deposition or etch machine, plasma-exposed chamber parts, quartz/ceramics, critical gas valves, proprietary coatings or guaranteed ultra-high-purity capability.
entry: Hire an equipment-sector manufacturing lead; secure drawing access, supplier requirements and paid sample work. Machine in-house. Use approved external vendors for anodising, passivation, heat treatment and specialist analytical testing until volumes justify internal investment.
capacity: Planning basis: four CNC machines, one eight-hour shift and 250 working days give 8,000 scheduled machine-hours/year. Budget 4,500–5,500 productive cutting hours after setups and downtime; piece output depends on actual cycle times.

budget.basis: INR crore on a September 2026 planning basis. Leased existing industrial shell; land purchase and new-building civil works excluded. Recoverable GST excluded, working capital separate, no subsidy deducted. Includes fixed equipment and stated pre-operative launch allowances; not an accounting classification or vendor quotation.

quality.title: Surface and cleanliness control
quality.detail: Define what contamination matters for each part. Semiconductor service cleaning illustrates the specialised controls needed; do not claim process-contact cleanliness from an ordinary wash.

title: AI-facility power distribution
plain: Build the electrical assemblies that divide incoming power safely among equipment circuits. Begin with AC distribution panels for data centres and industrial facilities.
analogy: A carefully protected set of main roads and junctions that routes electricity to the right destination.
product: Engineered low-voltage AC distribution boards with formed copper busbars, approved protection devices, labelled wiring and test documentation.
does: Routes and protects electrical supplies while giving operators clear isolation, monitoring and maintenance points.
customers: Approved switchboard OEMs seeking manufacturing partners
Colocation and enterprise data-centre operators through their consultants
Industrial facilities and semiconductor-factory electrical contractors
whyNow: ABB's announced India manufacturing expansion includes critical infrastructure products. NVIDIA's 800 VDC roadmap shows rising AI power-system demands, but it is a future architecture and a separate qualification problem. The starter sells defined AC distribution assemblies, not an assumed compatible 800 VDC system. [S1] [S2]
firstProduct: Indoor 415 VAC distribution-board families, with an initial assumed 630–2,500 A range under an established, verified assembly design platform. Each contract specifies prospective fault current, enclosure, protection, environment and maintainability.
notIncluded: No utility transformer, UPS power electronics, GPU power shelf, proprietary circuit breaker or complete 800 VDC system. Standalone busway is a separate product scope with its own applicable standard and verification.
entry: Secure an appropriate OEM assembly-system agreement and an experienced panel-design lead. Form and finish approved copper busbars, assemble and wire in-house. Buy approved devices and outsource sheet-metal manufacture, coating, plating and high-power verification initially.
capacity: Planning basis: 120–180 cubicles/year after qualification, one eight-hour shift and 250 working days. A complete distribution board may contain several cubicles; this is not a commitment to 180 complete switchboards.

machines.spec: No burrs or metal debris allowed in final assemblies; avoid unapproved changes to verified geometry.

machines.name: Wire cutting, stripping and crimping tools
machines.purpose: Prepare consistent cable and control-wire terminations.
machines.spec: Terminal, conductor and crimp tooling compatibility follows device instructions.

machines.name: Assembly benches and controlled torque tools
machines.purpose: Build supports and tighten electrical joints repeatably.
machines.spec: Use specified fasteners, joint surfaces and torque; maintain calibration.

machines.name: Electrical design and drawing workstations
machines.purpose: Manage single-line diagrams, BOMs and wiring revisions.
machines.spec: Use the selected assembly platform's design limits and device coordination data.

machines.name: Dielectric, insulation and continuity instrument set
machines.purpose: Carry out applicable routine electrical verification.
machines.spec: Test method, voltage and sequence from applicable standard and approved instructions; not generic fixed settings.

machines.name: Low-resistance and functional test instrument set
machines.purpose: Check selected joints and protection/control functions.
machines.spec: Micro-ohmmeter and injection/test accessories matched to the ordered devices and inspection plan.

machines.name: Handling and dispatch equipment
machines.purpose: Move and pack completed cubicles safely.
machines.spec: Rated trolleys, lifting fixtures and packing designed around product mass.

process.name: Translate the site requirement
process.plain: Agree what the panel must supply and protect.
process.detail: Obtain single-line diagram, load schedule, fault level, ambient conditions and consultant specifications.
process.check: Approved technical specification and responsibility matrix.

process.name: Select a verified configuration
process.plain: Stay within a proven assembly design.
process.detail: Choose enclosure, conductors, supports, devices and cooling arrangement under the original manufacturer's instructions.
process.check: Evidence covering the actual configuration; deviations require further verification.

process.name: Inspect incoming materials
process.plain: Check copper, supports and devices.
process.detail: Match dimensions, ratings and certificates; keep substituted components out of the approved BOM.
process.check: Traceable accepted materials and correct device variants.

process.name: Form the copper conductors
process.plain: Cut, punch and bend the electrical paths.
process.detail: Produce geometry from controlled drawings; remove burrs and outsource any required plating.
process.check: Dimensions, surface condition and joint locations match approved design.

process.name: Build the mechanical assembly
process.plain: Fit devices and their supports.
process.detail: Maintain clearances and conductor support arrangement; apply approved fasteners and joints.
process.check: Mounting, separation and documented joint torque.

process.name: Wire and identify circuits
process.plain: Connect controls, meters and outgoing circuits.
process.detail: Use approved terminal methods, wire sizes, protection settings and durable labels.
process.check: Drawing-to-wire check and correct identification.

process.name: Perform routine verification and FAT
process.plain: Check the finished assembly before shipping.
process.detail: Follow the applicable routine-verification plan; demonstrate ordered controls and records to the customer.
process.check: Signed test results and closed defects; design verification remains a separate obligation.

process.name: Preserve, dispatch and support installation
process.plain: Deliver the assembly with usable documentation.
process.detail: Pack for transport; provide lifting, installation, settings and maintenance information.
process.check: Release pack, serial identity and installation responsibilities agreed.

roadmap.actions: Choose AC product family, identify assembly-platform terms and obtain three target project specifications.
roadmap.gate: Named technical authority and a feasible approved configuration.

roadmap.phase: Prototype and cost the complete BOM
roadmap.actions: Obtain device, copper, enclosure and laboratory quotes; build a representative prototype.
roadmap.gate: Credible product cost and verification plan with design rights resolved.

roadmap.actions: Set up the cell, train staff and complete the necessary design-verification programme.
roadmap.gate: Applicable evidence for the actual assembly family and trained test personnel.

roadmap.actions: Produce controlled batches, conduct FATs and record installation feedback.
roadmap.gate: Accepted deliveries and closed quality issues.

roadmap.actions: Improve purchasing and assembly flow; extend configurations only within verified limits.
roadmap.gate: Repeat orders, cash collection and field reliability justify expansion.

quality.title: Assembly-level verification
quality.detail: IEC 61439-1 gives general rules and is used with the relevant product part; IEC 61439-2 covers power switchgear and controlgear assemblies. Device certificates alone do not verify a finished board.

quality.title: Design changes
quality.detail: Maintain the original manufacturer's permitted configurations. Changing a breaker, busbar support or ventilation detail may affect the verification evidence.

quality.title: Routine testing and safe FAT
quality.detail: Verify each completed assembly using the applicable standard and agreed inspection plan. Protect personnel through controlled access, isolation and suitable instruments.

quality.title: External high-power testing
quality.detail: Discuss required tests, laboratory scope, sample configuration and scheduling with a capable accredited facility such as CPRI. Laboratory presence does not establish certification or an available test slot.

localisation.part: Copper busbar fabrication, assembly and wiring
localisation.detail: Own local design execution, conversion, testing and service documentation.
Use approved Indian fabricators while preserving required geometry and finish.
Purchase approved variants; local brand presence does not prove Indian origin of each SKU.
Avoid building a dedicated short-circuit laboratory for the first plant.

schemes.name: ECMS and manufacturing incentives
schemes.status: No blanket eligibility assumed for an electrical-panel factory.
schemes.detail: The notified product category and eligible investment must match the application. General data-centre growth does not make every power-distribution product eligible. Obtain product-specific written advice; no subsidy is deducted from this budget and the same central eligible cost must not be claimed twice.

network: Use introductions to data-centre EPC procurement, electrical consultants, approved assembly-platform OEMs and Karnataka industrial projects. The strongest early network outcome is inclusion in a technically suitable vendor list and a paid pilot order; a political connection does not remove technical approvals or procurement rules.

risks.risk: Project opportunities require approvals the new supplier does not hold.
risks.response: Enter through a qualified assembly partner and agree the exact responsibility for design evidence.

risks.risk: Copper and protection-device purchases consume cash before customer payment.
risks.response: Negotiate advances, milestone billing and procurement against approved drawings.

risks.risk: A configuration change invalidates existing evidence.
risks.response: Control BOM and drawings and require engineering sign-off on every substitution.

risks.risk: The AI power roadmap changes faster than the initial product.
risks.response: Sell the defined AC range first; treat 800 VDC as a separately funded partner programme.

first90: Select a single AC assembly family and hire an experienced design authority.
Meet three EPC/consultant sourcing teams and request actual specification packs.
Get assembly-platform terms plus comparable breaker, copper and enclosure quotations.
Agree the representative verification programme and obtain laboratory quotations.
Build and cost one pilot configuration before committing to the full factory.
